From hello to reorder

Here’s how
we work.

Nothing complicated.
Just a clear conversation at each stage.

Select

We get to know your range, wholesale offer and permitted sales channels, and look at where there’s a fit.

Purchase

We agree on quantities, prices, payment terms and delivery details before placing an order.

Fulfill

We coordinate preparation and fulfillment for the products and channels we’ve agreed on, with accurate product information.

Reorder

We review replenishment opportunities and keep in touch as the relationship develops.

Put an introduction together

A few questions you might have

Before we talk.

Who do you buy from?+

Consumer brands and authorized distributors. We’ll ask about your range, sourcing documentation and wholesale terms so we can understand the opportunity.

Where do you sell?+

Our focus is leading U.S. online marketplaces, including Amazon where supplier permissions and marketplace requirements allow. We discuss intended sales channels before purchasing.

What about order sizes and payment terms?+

We agree on quantities, payment terms, lead times and delivery arrangements for each opportunity. Tell us how you usually work when you get in touch.

Can you share your business documents?+

Yes. Le Biz Brands LLC is a Florida LLC with a federal EIN and Florida Resale Certificate. Cristina can share the relevant documents during supplier onboarding.

Is this a product catalog?+

No. This site introduces our business and what we’re interested in buying. The unbranded product images are illustrative; they don’t represent current inventory or brand partnerships.
